prise_de_masse.title: Muscle gain

settings.title: Nutrition display
settings.sub: Choose how you want to see your guides.

plain.title: No tracking
plain.sub: Macros show up as a guide. You don't count anything, you don't tick anything.

tracked.title: With tracking
tracked.sub: You follow your macros and calories through the day. No red, no judgment.

settings.editorial: You can change your mind anytime.
